GenAiFunction.description: Use this when the customer asks about their bill — the amount due, when it is due, why it changed, what a charge is, or how to pay. Shows a statement card with the total due, a stacked charge-category bar, itemized line items, a month-over-month delta explanation, and pay / autopay actions.
GenAiFunction.masterLabel: ASA Technology, Media & Comms · Bill Explainer
